level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. THE STRUCTURE, which is what this bank is for: RAILTEL is a range with an unusually asymmetric map. Below sits a three-source floor at 282.45-287.82 (weekly EMA200 between a rung of each ladder). Above sits the densest obstacle on the name — fourteen sources inside 6.4% at 295.55-314.44, containing the entire daily Ichimoku, the Supertrend, both BMSB rails, three daily averages, a rung from each ladder and the operator's own mid-conviction box drawn around the lot. Between them is 2.7% of near-empty air. That makes the name binary and cheap to monitor from a price alone: inside the floor cluster it is at support with a defined invalidation; above 314.44 it has cleared the one thing that matters; below 282.45 it falls through a 6.5% void to the operator's teal band. The two falling rails descend INTO the gate rather than sitting above it, so with time the rail test and the gate test become the same event.
